step1_analysis.description: A differential steering charge pump with dummy branches to maintain constant current draw, typically used in a PLL. It includes a constant bleed current sink (XM7) likely to avoid PFD dead zone, and uses a self-biasing or filtered bias scheme where the PMOS bias (N3) is tied to the output via a continuously-ON transistor (XM2).

paper_reference.title: A Single-Chip Digitally Calibrated 5.15–5.825-GHz 0.18-um CMOS Transceiver for 802.11a Wireless LAN

I_bleed.description: Constant bleed current sinking from the output node to avoid PFD dead zone

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on square law for NMOS in SKY130 at 0.9V bias.

I_up_net.description: Net sourcing current when UP is active (excluding bleed)

sky130_expected.calculation: Id of XM1 with Vsg=0.9V (since N3 is shorted to OUT via XM2). 0.5 * up*Cox * (W/L) * (Vsg-|Vth|)^2 = 0.5 * 50u * 10 * (0.9-0.42)^2 = 57uA
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on square law for PMOS in SKY130 at 0.9V bias.

I_dn_net.description: Net sinking current when DN is active (excluding bleed)

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on square law for NMOS in SKY130 at 0.9V bias.

step3_testbench.description: Measures the bleed, UP, and DN currents of the charge pump by forcing the output to 0.9V and toggling the input logic signals. Includes a transient analysis to observe dynamic switching.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Charge Pump Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u
.param W_xm14=5u L_xm14=0.5u

XM1 N4 N3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 OUT GND N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 OUT UP_BAR N4 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N0 GND N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 LABEL_NET_2 N3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 OUT VDD OUT GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 OUT N6 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N1 N3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N7 VDD N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N0 DN_BAR N10 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N5 N6 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 OUT DN N10 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM13 N10 N6 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}
XM14 N4 UP N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm14} w={W_xm14}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VN6 N6 0 0.9
VOUT OUT 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_2 0 0.9

* Logic Inputs with pulse for transient
VUP UP 0 pulse(1.8 0 1n 0.1n 0.1n 5n 20n)
VUP_BAR UP_BAR 0 pulse(1.8 0 1n 0.1n 0.1n 5n 20n)
VDN DN 0 pulse(0 1.8 11n 0.1n 0.1n 5n 20n)
VDN_BAR DN_BAR 0 pulse(1.8 0 11n 0.1n 0.1n 5n 20n)

.control
  * 1. Transient Analysis (uses the pulse definitions)
  tran 0.1n 20n
  meas tran i_up_peak max i(VOUT)
  meas tran i_dn_peak min i(VOUT)

  * 2. Measure Bleed/Leakage Current (DC)
  alter VUP 1.8
  alter VUP_BAR 1.8
  alter VDN 0
  alter VDN_BAR 1.8
  op
  let i_bleed = -i(VOUT)
  print i_bleed

  * 3. Measure UP Current (DC)
  alter VUP 0
  alter VUP_BAR 0
  alter VDN 0
  alter VDN_BAR 1.8
  op
  let i_up_total = i(VOUT)
  let i_up_net = i_up_total + i_bleed
  print i_up_total i_up_net

  * 4. Measure DN Current (DC)
  alter VUP 1.8
  alter VUP_BAR 1.8
  alter VDN 1.8
  alter VDN_BAR 0
  op
  let i_dn_total = -i(VOUT)
  let i_dn_net = i_dn_total - i_bleed
  print i_dn_total i_dn_net

  quit
.endc
